item.title: Show HN: Ohm – Use uBlock Origin cosmetic filters in Chrome again
item.summary: Ohm parses uBlock Origin cosmetic filter lists client-side and turns them into a real Manifest V3 Chrome extension scoped to exactly a list of sites. It's free, open source, and collects no data. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49251938 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
